title: Diagnose a hot-key join
description: Change the join strategy, reducer count, hot-key share, and small-side memory contract. The reducer view exposes why more reducers do not split one equal key.
modelNote: This is a bounded load-distribution model, not a Pig runtime predictor. Real partition sizes depend on serialized keys and values, combiners, sampling, spill, compression, and the selected execution backend.

strategies.label: Regular hash join
strategies.detail: Both relations are partitioned by key. Equal keys remain together on one reducer.
strategies.resultRule: Best when key frequencies are reasonably even and both inputs require distributed matching.

strategies.label: Skewed join
strategies.detail: Pig samples key frequencies and gives hot keys a specialized distribution plan.
strategies.resultRule: Useful for measured hot keys, with extra sampling and planning work.

strategies.label: Replicated join
strategies.detail: The small relation is made available to map tasks so the large side avoids a reduce-side join.
strategies.resultRule: Valid only when every replicated input fits the configured size and task-memory contract.
